name: MajorGiftMovesManager
tagline: Moves management for major gift officers – portfolios, stage gates, next moves and a weighted pipeline in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete major gift moves-management app: gift-officer portfolios moving prospects from Identify to Qualify, Cultivate, Solicit and Steward with stage gates; capacity and affinity ratings with a capacity × affinity matrix; planned asks, probabilities and a weighted pipeline; overdue and missing next moves; a moves calendar with contact reports; ask outcomes and pledges; and portfolio balancing against a target size. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Identify → Qualify → Cultivate → Solicit → Steward with stage gates
Capacity bands and capacity × affinity matrix
Planned ask, probability and weighted pipeline
Overdue / missing next move, stalled and contact-gap alerts
Log moves with contact report and next move
Ask outcomes: verbal yes, pledged, deferred, declined
Portfolio cards, target size and balance suggestions
